title: Why Your Car Pulls Sideways (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Stop letting a stuck caliper pull you.

script.narration: Part 2! Stop letting a stuck caliper pull you.
script.visual_search: mechanic working on car brake caliper

script.narration: If your steering wheel yanks to one side when you brake, a sliding brake pin is likely seized. The caliper refuses to release pressure from the rotor. That constant friction drags one wheel down while the other rolls freely, forcing your car off a straight path.
script.visual_search: car brake rotor spinning close up

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Has your car ever pulled sideways? Comment yes or no, because...
script.visual_search: car driving on straight road steering wheel

description: Part 2 of our series on why your car pulls sideways. Discover how a stuck brake caliper or seized slider pin creates dangerous steering pull and uneven braking resistance.
why_it_will_work: Directly continues a popular car maintenance theme, promising clear answers to a common mechanical problem.
